name: Dubverse
summary: Dubverse is an AI-powered video translation and dubbing platform that enables fast, accurate localization using a global voice library.
description: Dubverse is an AI-powered video translation and dubbing platform that enables fast, accurate localization using a global voice library. Dubverse is a Generative AI platform with best in class AI Video Dubbing, AI Text to Speech, Auto Subtitles & API. Dubverse uses artificial intelligence to best in class Video Dubbing AI translation: Converts video speech to subtitles and voice in over 30 languages, opening content to new audiences. Voice cloning: Maintain the original speaker’s style and tone for a more authentic dub. Fast turnaround: Get dubbed videos in minutes, making localization efficient even for large projects. Subtitle and transcript generation: Automated, editable subtitles and full transcripts to complement any video.

howToUse.title: Register and Sign In
howToUse.description: Go to Dubverse and create an account. Log in to access your dashboard and start dubbing projects.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Video
howToUse.description: Start a new project and upload your video file. Supported formats include MP4, MOV, and others.

howToUse.title: Select Target Language(s)
howToUse.description: Choose one or more target languages you want your video to be dubbed into. Dubverse supports over 30 languages.

howToUse.title: Pick Voice and Cloning Options
howToUse.description: Select from a variety of AI voices or use voice cloning for original style retention. Adjust gender, accent, and tone as desired.

howToUse.title: AI Translation and Dubbing
howToUse.description: Dubverse will automatically transcribe, translate, and generate the dubbed audio with accurate lip-sync using AI.

howToUse.title: Review Transcript and Dubbing
howToUse.description: Edit the generated transcript, subtitles, or audio if needed to ensure high-quality output.

howToUse.title: Export Video with Subtitles
howToUse.description: Export your dubbed video and download it, or share via Dubverse’s provided link. You can also download the subtitle and transcript files.

howToUse.title: API Automation (For Developers)
howToUse.description: Use the Dubverse API for batch processing and workflow integration in large-scale localization projects.

features_fr: Traduction IA : convertit le discours vidéo en sous-titres et en voix dans plus de 30 langues, ouvrant ainsi le contenu à de nouveaux publics.
Clonage de voix : conservez le style et le ton de l'orateur d'origine pour un doublage plus authentique.
Délai d'exécution rapide : obtenez des vidéos doublées en quelques minutes, ce qui rend la localisation efficace même pour les grands projets.
Génération de sous-titres et de transcriptions : sous-titres automatisés et modifiables et transcriptions complètes pour compléter n'importe quelle vidéo.
